summary: The F25 symlink fix holds on its own case: a symlink chain and a symlink to a post outside the posts dir in th are both read, and the title rule fails naming each link. One silent skip remains: a symlink to a directory named .md is dropped by listPostFiles and not reported by brokenPostRefs, while the phase-base test and blog.ts crash loudly with EISDIR. ADV-22 routes to Green with a committed failing probe.
blocking_findings: ADV-22 [Blocker] adversarial: the loader silently skips a symlink to a directory named .md. listPostFiles in src/__tests__/fixtures/blog-posts-loader.ts accepts a symlink only when statSync(fullPath).isFile(); for a directory target isFile() is false, so the entry is dropped, and brokenPostRefs reports it only when statSync throws, which it does not. A temporary th/zz-adv-dirlink.md pointing at a real directory left all 17 validation cases green, while the phase-base test (git show 257a6b0cd^: readdirSync names filtered by endsWith('.md'), read with readFileSync) and blog.ts readFileSync crash with EISDIR. Route-to-Green: surface directory symlinks whose name ends .md (for example in a non-file refs list asserted empty, or by parsing them so the read fails loudly). The committed probe src/__tests__/blog-posts-loader.adversarial.test.ts fails its ADV-22 case until the fix lands.
nonblocking_findings: ADV-23 [Note] adversarial: a locale-level symlink to a directory is skipped by localeDirectories (dirent.isDirectory() is false for a symlink), so posts under a symlinked locale directory are not validated; blog.ts iterates fixed locale names, so this only matters if a locale dir were replaced by a symlink.
evidence: A temporary two-link chain th/zz-adv-chain1.md -> th/zz-adv-chain2.md -> an outside target with no title failed the title rule naming th/zz-adv-chain1 and th/zz-adv-chain2.
A temporary th/zz-adv-outside.md -> an outside target with no title failed the title rule naming th/zz-adv-outside (the F25 case).
A temporary th/zz-adv-dirlink.md -> a real directory left all 17 cases green (silent skip); every temporary file, link, directory, and outside target was removed and git status is clean.
The committed probe at 865f52a91 passes its two held cases and fails its ADV-22 case against a temp tree under /home/daniebo/.cache/opencode, which self-cleans.

ratings.evidence: The F25 fix reads chained and outside symlinks, but a directory symlink named .md is skipped silently (blog-posts-loader.adversarial.test.ts fails 1 of 3).
Two of three symlink probes fail loudly and name the link; the third is the silent class the loader claims to reject.
Every probe was temporary and removed; the only commit updates the probe file.
The phase-base comparison and the isolated green run are quoted command results.
